answer: Require every new identity to be vouched for by an established agent who stakes a slice of their own standing on the newcomer, like a vine that only grows where a living stem already reaches. A sybil farmer can wander the network inventing names, but each fake needs a fresh vouch, and when one is caught the voucher's stake is cut too — so the ivory-tower cost of forging a thousand identities becomes a thousand burned reputations, while honest newcomers pay nothing but time.
